brief.audience: Drivers around Telford whose everyday car has become a takeaway graveyard.
brief.problem: A familiar messy-car problem needs a memorable, credible reason to book a professional interior detail.
brief.action: Message Defined Detail to enquire about an interior detail.

proof.claim: Defined Detail offers interior wet detailing in Telford.

brief.tone: Understated British comedy. Earnest characters, natural conversation and enough silence for the reaction.
avoid: Speeding up speech to fit an arbitrary duration
Treating a successful file encode as creative approval

script.premise: An estate agent treats a dirty car as an attractive property. The owner punctures the sales pitch.
script.whyFunny: The estate agent is completely sincere. The incongruity and the owner's reaction carry the joke, rather than a shouting performance.

lines.speaker: Estate agent
lines.performance: Sincere, measured property sales patter. Point, then let the phrase land.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.performance: Baffled, conversational. Pause after Mate. No broad mugging.

script.closingCopy: Defined Detail. Interior detailing in Telford. Message us to book.
script.closingDelivery: Approximately 6–7 seconds. Warm, conversational British read. A smile rather than an announcer. Let the name and Telford breathe.

voice.direction: Use the natural warmth and measured finish of the CTN reference. The Defined Detail script still needs its own dry recording and an explicit listening review.

auditions.name: Adam Stone · the CTN reference
auditions.script: Existing library preview. Tone reference only; this is not Defined Detail copy.
